issue.body:
Track: P — same sole external Codex producer

# C1223 — LOCAL IMPLEMENTATION RELEASE: selected direct receiver optional same-D root read

**Start now in the existing P Codex build environment.** This is a separate bounded local mission after P1531 COMPLETE. Keep PR1532/public branch and all original FIRST/RED/evidence frozen. No Compiler remote publication or CI is released here. Issue creation is a release, not proof that the external P actor has started; record ACTUAL START.

## Authority, goal and measured boundary

First follow Compiler/main docs/NewLang_Project_Compass.md to the actual Product Value Strategy §§1.1/1.3, Process §§4.1.2/4.3.2 and CURRENT_SPEC. Operational main is **b2f22d39b61c0cf3ea18b7a1529fa8f0bf801be1**, tree **e2795182a2128d658cde3c2b1d4190aca25c0a41**, canonical **Draft17.38**. Recheck live main; report drift rather than silently changing the fixed input.

The fixed local implementation base is the completed, still unadopted PR1532 **b1a6f1725abe25981ad29088175de581f956f919**, tree **1fb87662e11c8e1ccd4d54a45be0e3d38a8e67b9**, sole parent c683ca533caaca05e1b546dd45f2a051295da81f. Use a new isolated P-owned worktree/branch; do not mutate the existing publication worktree/ref.

Canonical §18.1a already selects an optional bounded same-D scoped root read before terminal teardown in the closed ordinary known-direct **unit-returning** receiver. [P1528 original FIRST](https://github.com/wakairo/NewLang_Compiler/issues/1528#issuecomment-6977779356), [FINAL](https://github.com/wakairo/NewLang_Compiler/issues/1528#issuecomment-6978142243) and [C1201 acceptance](https://github.com/wakairo/NewLang_Compiler/issues/1528#issuecomment-6978263025) measured source CHECK and genuine public-owned five ordered steps for zero/42, then C17 CLI4; native NOT_RUN. Its new operation obtains/discards a root reference, not callee payload projection/use or u8 return. Old measurements remain at old7de; remeasure a concise baseline on fixed b1a6 before implementing.

**Goal:** complete a coherent, reusable private consumer path for this already-selected five-step direct receiver, preserving the genuine source/definition/actual-call proof and existing four-step capability. No new source selection or public issuer is authorized. “Change a count4 to5” is not an assumed correct solution; trace and reuse the actual body/world/read validation and emission.

## P captain autonomy / accepted scope

P chooses the smallest coherent supported source family, internal design, test order and local repairs within this boundary. Post own provisional source/oracle, expected first failure and scope before execution; retain every original version and first RED. May reuse own P1528 originals/probe and other own existing apparatus with exact provenance. Do not inspect/import independent F/R source, oracle, runner, raw, reports or their PRs. C will relay only a minimum finding if needed.

Authorized edits: private C17 consumer/planning/emission and focused P-owned tests/docs/CMake registration needed for the declared direct five-step capability. Existing authentic body/source/world/issuer, actual/formal substitutions, full original R/Allocation/Domain/root/incarnation and authority/order validation must remain mandatory. The scoped read must close before exclusive EndRoot; no ownership is minted by type/count/name, no producer/LiveTail relabelling and no alternate proof or fixture-specific engine. Preserve original H0/H1/H2 failure worlds, truezero, caller payload observation, both originals and physical free order, same-original-T old/current/sibling when composed, no-clobber/rollback and pristine retry. Keep new prefix bindings direct-only and old zero-prefix LiveTail behavior.

Own positive zero/nonzero and unchanged four-step controls; relevant wrong Domain/actual authority, live loan at EndRoot and post-EndRoot read negatives; declared unsupported legal combinations must fail closed. Use risk-proportionate source→CHECK→genuine public-owned→C17/API agreement→strict native/sanitizer checks. P determines which narrow private path and failure injections materially need verification; no broad duplicate full CTest sweep.

Local planning/read/implementation iteration is autonomous; a failed local candidate is preserved and stopped, then may be safely repaired inside scope. Ordinary mechanical fixes do not require C approval per attempt. Any inability to reuse the existing genuine consumer safely returns a concrete blocker/proposal rather than inventing a new public mechanism.

## Finite new-mission budget / frozen publication

- Up to **128 selected local invocations**, counting nested compiler/probe/test commands honestly; administrative Git/read/hash/custody separately logged, no unbounded hidden campaign.
- Up to **24 generated-C native guest executions**, **2 frontend builds**, **2 public-probe builds**. Select strict GCC plus pinned Clang sanitizer coverage proportionate to the changed path; report actual configurations/worlds and NOT_RUN.
- If the changed path needs focused host failure verification: up to **4 sites /12 cases**; no unrelated fault sweep. Existing evidence is cited with its original SHA, not called new execution.
- SDK/network toolchain acquisition **0**; reuse the already validated pinned LLVM23.1.3 environment.
- Compiler remote branches/commits/push/PR/Actions/manual retry/READY/merge **0**. Local commits allowed. Do not move PR1532, old PR1526, R branches or any stopped sibling.
- One new ordinary-Git Evidence ref/push, at most **512 files/16MiB**, may preserve this local mission's FIRST/source/patch/commit objects/ledger/raw. No LFS/SDK/build binaries/independent originals. Record path/size/SHA256/mode manifest; verify a full fresh empty HTTPS clone before deleting only your redundant custody staging/restore copies. Keep active worktree, original raw, baseline tools and prior evidence.

At ~75% of a relevant budget, post a progress checkpoint and prioritize closure. Exceeding a cap needs C adjudication, not a quiet reset.

## Priority and completion

Current PR1532 adoption has priority. If C relays a material correction for the frozen current candidate, checkpoint this local work and stop its execution so the same sole P can address the critical dependency; do not infer R findings by opening R materials. Another main SHA arriving is not permission to rebase/publish this local candidate.

Return **LOCAL_READY / bounded declared capability** with exact local parent/HEAD/tree, diff, own FIRST/RED, all reached layers/negative/failure results and custody; or **NO_NARROW_REUSE / STOP C** with the actual first obstacle and smallest next decision. C will separately choose integration/publication and independent review. This local result is not main adoption.

## Goal / alternatives / value-alignment risk / STOP

This explicitly replaces the implementation HOLD from P1528/C1201 **only for the limited local consumer work above**. It closes selected v0 backend coverage and tests whether existing machinery really reuses across sources. Current observable caller-side payload→four-step teardown→T continuation already works without the extra callee root read; therefore five-step support is not falsely presented as necessary for that operation or as a practical library completion. Keeping four-step-only and postponing this optional selected coverage is the immediate alternative; implementing callee payload use/u8 result or general ownership is a separate source/scope question. The chosen local parallel work preserves the current adoption path and avoids spending new CI before it is settled.

**VALUE-ALIGNMENT-RISK (separate from technical results):** an obtained/discarded root read does not demonstrate useful callee payload use, an ordinary-safe API/all safe-reachable states, or reduced library-author+ordinary-safe-caller UB audit/re-audit dependency closure versus well-factored C. Do not grow a fixture-specific trusted mechanism merely to gain a green case. ProductGO624 PAUSED/H1 HOLD/comparative value UNMEASURED; fair sound Rust alternatives retained.

STOP C for genuine unsound CHECK/authority/current/loan/owner/original-identity/OOM/rollback/cleanup, any new canonical/source/public issuer/API/ABI/ownership/proof trust, body/category expansion including callee payload projection or non-unit return, scope/target/isolation/budget drift. Preserve failure evidence before stopping; no unsafe execution to force completion.

## P autonomy retrospective

Previous C1213 delegated a fixed direct-only boundary, local repair/test order and one remaining public push: P chose a minimal guard and own regression, used38/40 selected+6/6 native+1/1 build and completed final8 green/custody without widening source/issuer. This time C fixes the selected capability and publication boundary; P chooses a coherent reusable consumer design and finite verification. The same distinction between local failed-candidate repair and mandatory source/authority escalation remains.

main b2f22d39b61c0cf3ea18b7a1529fa8f0bf801be1 / Draft17.38。
固定local base b1a6f1725abe25981ad29088175de581f956f919 / tree1fb87662e11c8e1ccd4d54a45be0e3d38a8e67b9。
別worktreeで、既選択§18.1aの同一D scoped root read＋unit terminal receiverを真正proofのままC17/nativeへ接続。P1528 own FIRST/REDを継承、現base baselineは別記録。
private consumerの方式・局所修復・有限検証はP裁量。新source/issuer/API/ABI/owner、callee payload/use/u8 returnは対象外。
128selected/24native/2frontend/2probe、必要host4sites12cases、SDK0。Compiler remote/PR/CI0、PR1532は固定。
R/F原資料を読まない。原FIRST/RED/rawを保持し、1Evidence ref≤512files/16MiBとfresh HTTPS全復元。
現採用候補のC修正指示を優先。LOCAL_READYまたは具体的NO_NARROW_REUSEをPOST/GETしSTOP C。詳細・STOPはIssue優先。
